name: sol_signature_4
description: Signature verification missing check that signer is the expected authorized entity
question: The source file in `source` recovers or verifies a signature over some message/action but never checks that the recovered signer (or the address used in the verification) equals the specific authorized/expected entity (such as a designated owner, oracle, or role holder) before trusting the signature and executing the associated privileged or sensitive action, allowing any validly-signed message from an arbitrary key to be accepted; this excludes code that explicitly compares the recovered address against a stored authorized address, role, or allowlist before proceeding.
criteria: ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) result is used directly to authorize a withdrawal or state change without comparing it to any stored owner/signer address
A function verifies a signature is valid (non-zero recovered address) but omits any check that the address equals msg.sender, owner, or an allowlisted signer
Signature verification checks only that the signature matches the message hash but never checks which specific address produced it against an expected role
Multi-step approval logic accepts any signature recovered from the message without matching it to a per-user or per-role expected signer set
